acceptance: Builder evidence; fresh Sonnet/high finisher bench required. M1-09 remains pending.
attemptNotes: Initial five-birth crude rate failed. Universal income/waiting calibration produced nine births; the one drawn town was used for calibration and requires a fresh-place finisher check.
Early exploratory factory-on/off runs were not comparisons with the original clean stack. Later clean-revision runs retained failed speed measurements of 55.07% and 5.52%.

Early exploratory timing omitted the published 8192 MiB heap policy. The partial default-heap alternating run was stopped during its second head process (SIGTERM, exit 143); named-branch restoration completed. Those measurements remain exploratory.
The first guard-configured registry-preserving head median was 110015.247 ms versus 93449.277 ms baseline, 17.73% slower: failed the unchanged 5% work-order limit and passed the 20% inherited limit.

The final production repair puts infancy eligibility on the newborn person record, retaining existing data registry identities and optional API compatibility. Profiles show financial guarded reads among expensive work, but no paired profile establishes the cause of timing variation.
An external copied runner initially used CommonJS and failed before advancing; its ESM extension repaired that tool error.
